distinct_angle: Iki sicaklikli iz: amber kaynak akisi, mavi dunyaya donen receipt; cusp hex fibre akisin secim noktasini gorunur kilar.
one_sentence_story: Bir kaynak artefakti amber bir iz uretir, iz Context Capsule icinde tek bir baglama sabitlenir, torus ailesinin cusp fibre'i uzerinden gecerek sagda ayri bir receipt/world trace'e ulasir; bunun yaninda S6 yalniz bir paper claim olarak acik kalir.

beats.visual_action: Soldaki koyu hex platformun ustunde tek, okunabilir SOURCE etiketi tasiyan krem renkli sayfa artefakti yukselir; altindaki amber halka sadece bu nesneyi aydinlatir.
beats.continuity: source_artifact sonraki butun beatlerde soldaki sabit origin noktasinda kalir.

beats.visual_action: Kaynak halkasindan tek amber spline cikar; spline uzerindeki seyrek nokta atimlari soldan merkeze ilerler. Arka plan agi gorunur ama hareket etmez.
beats.voiceover: Kaynak, kanit izini tek bir akista tasir.
beats.continuity: amber_stream kaynakta baslar ve beat 3te kapsulun icine girer; yeni paralel akis acilmaz.

beats.visual_action: Akisin orta dugumunde seffaf dikdortgen Context Capsule cizilir. Akisin onundeki tek isaret kapsul icinde durur; kapsul icinde sadece CONTEXT etiketi bulunur.
beats.voiceover: Baglam, izi suslemek icin degil, onu tasimak icin tutar.
beats.continuity: context_capsule beat 3te olusur ve beat 5e kadar saydam govde olarak kalir; amber nokta icinde kilitlenir.

beats.visual_action: Kapsulun cevresinde iki ince torus ve bir yarim torus ailesi acilir. Tek mavi cusp hexagonal fibre, amber noktayi bir kavisle sag yone tasir; diger toruslar soluk kalir.
beats.voiceover: Secim noktasi, izi bir sonraki dunyaya baglayan cusp'tur.
beats.continuity: torus_family kapsul merkezine ortalanir; cusp_fibre tek aktif rota olarak beat 5e uzanir.

beats.causal_move: route closes against a receipt/world trace
beats.visual_action: Mavi fibre sagdaki kagit receipt ve altindaki concentric world trace halkasinda sonlanir. Receipt yaninda iki satirlik buyuk, okunabilir metin belirir: S6 CLAIM / PAPER CLAIM. Metin damga gibi kapanmaz; etrafindaki halka acik bir kontur olarak kalir.
beats.voiceover: Bu kapanis, S6 icin bir paper claimdir; receipt ve world trace olmadan consensus degildir.
beats.continuity: source_artifact, amber_stream, context_capsule ve torus_family kadrajda kalir; receipt_world_trace son durum olarak sagda kalir.

persistent_objects.final_state: still visible as origin, no duplicate

caption_script.hook: What does an evidence thread look like when the claim stays falsifiable?
beats: The trace moves as a single luminous stream.
Context holds the trace at one readable point.
A cusp fibre selects the route through a torus family.
The endpoint is a receipt/world trace; S6 remains a paper claim, not consensus fact.
caption_script.closing_caption: Source -> trace -> context -> cusp -> receipt/world trace. S6: paper claim, awaiting falsification.
caption_script.copy_rule: All on-screen text is short, exact, and rendered as real text; no pseudo-text texture.

timing.easing: smooth, fixed per beat; no random timing

determinism.camera: fixed orthographic camera; no camera shake; no depth-of-field

construction_order: Create fixed hex platform polygons and static background graph nodes.
Create source_artifact as a Rectangle plus two Text lines; write once, then hold.
Animate one CubicBezier amber_stream with a fixed list of 31 control samples.
Create context_capsule as transparent Prism-like rectangle with fixed opacity 0.22.
Create three ParametricFunction torus projections with radii [0.92, 1.14, 1.36]; opacity [0.55, 0.38, 0.22].
Create cusp_fibre as one cyan CubicBezier with a fixed hexagonal cusp marker.
Create receipt_world_trace from a paper Rectangle, two Text objects, and four concentric Ellipse outlines.
Use LaggedStart only for object reveal; all object positions and labels are explicit constants.
manim_plan.text_safety: Use real Manim Text with font_size 28-34, max two short lines at endpoint; never raster pseudo-text.

falsifier.statement: If the source pointer cannot be linked to the displayed receipt/world trace through a reproducible event sequence, or if an independent rerun produces a different route, this visual does not support the S6 claim.
required_checks: source pointer resolves to a specific artifact
world trace contains a matching event or snapshot receipt
same fixed Manim inputs reproduce the same five-beat route
independent evaluator can identify the claim as a paper claim rather than a consensus fact
falsifier.visual_behavior_on_failure: Keep PAPER CLAIM outline open and turn the endpoint fibre gray; never show a verified stamp.
